features: unchanged 12 pre-helper features from experiment 14; no additional native inference or auxiliary result features
objective: delta=baseline_pages-helper_pages-lambda; label=delta>0, sample_weight=abs(delta); lambda is an experimental page-equivalent call penalty, not measured money, CPU or tokens
fit: FP32 weighted BCE; same trainer as 14; no quantization until useful full-precision signal
folds: test repo i, train (i+1)%3, validation (i+2)%3; etcd-io/etcd, kubernetes/test-infra, lxc/lxd
epoch_selection: minimum validation weighted BCE; earliest tie
threshold_selection: existing CalibratePageBudget on validation only at 90% helper-call cap; minimize pages, tie fewer calls; disabled included; equal scores indivisible
penalty_selection: choose validation-calibrated candidate minimizing validation pages, then calls, then smaller penalty; never compare held-out metrics to select
gate: same as 15 at 90%: pages<=always-helper, observed calls<=90%, Recall1/10>=raw; learned policies must Pareto dominate gap control in pages and calls with at least one strict improvement
audit: report objective tie weights, chosen penalties and all candidate validation metrics; verify zero-penalty fits reproduce archived 14 FP32 weights; report held-out cost after selection
independence: previously observed docstring queries from three repos; exploratory leave-one-repo-out, not fresh final evidence; no CoSQA reserve use
output: all 30 numerical heads local only pending publication verification; aggregate metadata/source only in Git
